name: v2-intro-0
text: 李太白邀君同游。|诗吟蜀道之险峻，歌咏云海之壮丽。

name: v2-intro-0-en
text: Li Bai invites you to wander. | Hear the perilous road to Shu, and the splendour of a sea of clouds.

name: v2-intro-1
text: 门外是长安夜色。|门内，一席灯火正盛。

name: v2-cue-1-touch
text: 门扉微凉。

name: v2-cue-1-open
text: 灯火深处，且入诗中。

name: v2-intro-1-en
text: Beyond the door lies Chang’an at night. | Within, the lamplight glows.

name: v2-cue-1-touch-en
text: The door is cool to the touch.

name: v2-cue-1-open-en
text: Beyond the lamplight, let us enter the poem.

name: v2-intro-2
text: 清酒映灯，珍馐满席。|眼前的丰盛，照不亮心底的阴影。

name: v2-cue-2-cup
text: 金樽清酒，斗十千。

name: v2-cue-2-taste
text: 玉盘珍羞，直万钱。

name: v2-cue-2-swallow
text: 珍馐入口，心事难消。

name: v2-intro-2-en
text: Clear wine catches the lamplight; fine dishes fill the table. | Yet abundance cannot dispel the shadow in the heart.

name: v2-cue-2-cup-en
text: Clear wine in golden cups, ten thousand coins a measure.

name: v2-cue-2-taste-en
text: Fine delicacies on jade plates, worth ten thousand more.

name: v2-cue-2-swallow-en
text: A taste of fine food. | Yet the troubled heart finds no ease.

name: v2-intro-3
text: 灯影未动，心绪已乱。

name: v2-cue-3-hesitate
text: 停杯。

name: v2-cue-3-stop
text: 投箸，不能食。

name: v2-intro-3-en
text: The lamplight is still. | The heart is restless.

name: v2-cue-3-hesitate-en
text: I set down my cup.

name: v2-cue-3-stop-en
text: I cast aside my chopsticks. | I cannot eat.

name: v2-intro-4
text: 满堂繁华，忽然退成寂静。

name: v2-cue-4-draw
text: 拔剑。

name: v2-cue-4-gaze
text: 四顾。|心茫然。

name: v2-intro-4-en
text: The splendour of the hall recedes into silence.

name: v2-cue-4-draw-en
text: I draw my sword.

name: v2-cue-4-gaze-en
text: I look about me. | My heart is lost.

name: v2-intro-5
text: 夜色四合。|天地虽阔，去路未明。

name: v2-cue-5-left
text: 廊下无人。

name: v2-cue-5-up
text: 抬眼，是一庭清月。

name: v2-cue-5-right
text: 回首，灯火已远。

name: v2-cue-5-down
text: 俯看，归路仍空。

name: v2-intro-5-en
text: Night closes in. | The world is vast, but the way ahead is unclear.

name: v2-cue-5-left-en
text: No one in the corridor.

name: v2-cue-5-up-en
text: Looking up, I find a courtyard filled with moonlight.

name: v2-cue-5-right-en
text: Looking back, the lamplight seems far away.

name: v2-cue-5-down-en
text: Looking down, the way home is still empty.

name: v2-intro-6
text: 长河横亘，寒气迎面。

name: v2-cue-6-river
text: 欲渡黄河。|冰塞川。

name: v2-intro-6-en
text: A great river bars the way. | The cold meets us head on.

name: v2-cue-6-river-en
text: I would cross the Yellow River. | Ice blocks its course.

name: v2-intro-7
text: 太行苍茫，风雪无边。

name: v2-cue-7-snow
text: 将登太行。|雪满山。

name: v2-intro-7-en
text: The Taihang Mountains stretch into a boundless storm.

name: v2-cue-7-snow-en
text: I would climb the Taihang Mountains. | Snow fills their heights.

name: v2-intro-8
text: 山路到了分岔处。|远近，皆是未卜之途。

name: v2-cue-8-roads
text: 行路难！|行路难！|多歧路，今安在？

name: v2-intro-8-en
text: The mountain path divides. | Near or far, every road is uncertain.

name: v2-cue-8-roads-en
text: Hard is the road! | Hard is the road! | So many paths. Where is my way now?

name: v2-intro-9
text: 别却席间心事，迎面已是蜀山。

name: v2-cue-9-height
text: 噫吁嚱！|危乎高哉！|蜀道之难，难于上青天。

name: v2-intro-9-en
text: We leave the troubled banquet behind. | The mountains of Shu rise before us.

name: v2-cue-9-height-en
text: Ah! | So perilous, so high! | The road to Shu is harder than climbing the blue heavens.

name: v2-intro-10
text: 古道藏在崖壁间，石色记着开山的往事。

name: v2-cue-10-path
text: 地崩山摧壮士死。|然后，天梯石栈相钩连。

name: v2-intro-10-en
text: An ancient path clings to the cliff. | Its stones remember the opening of the mountains.

name: v2-cue-10-path-en
text: Earth split, mountains crumbled, and the brave men died. | Only then did skyward ladders and cliff paths link the way.

name: v2-intro-11
text: 云端是日月，足下是江流。

name: v2-cue-11-high
text: 上有六龙回日之高标。

name: v2-cue-11-low
text: 下有冲波逆折之回川。

name: v2-intro-11-en
text: Above the clouds, the sun and moon. | Beneath our feet, the river.

name: v2-cue-11-high-en
text: Above, a peak so high that the sun’s six dragons turn their chariot back.

name: v2-cue-11-low-en
text: Below, a river turns back upon itself in surging waves.

name: v2-intro-12
text: 青泥岭上，来路渐隐。

name: v2-cue-12-bends
text: 青泥何盘盘。|百步九折萦岩峦。

name: v2-intro-12-en
text: On Qingni Ridge, the path behind us fades from sight.

name: v2-cue-12-bends-en
text: How Qingni twists and winds! | In a hundred paces, nine turns coil around the rocky peaks.

name: v2-intro-13
text: 夜空低垂，万籁俱寂。

name: v2-cue-13-stars
text: 扪参历井，仰胁息。

name: v2-cue-13-sigh
text: 以手抚膺，坐长叹。

name: v2-intro-13-en
text: The night sky hangs low. | Every sound is stilled.

name: v2-cue-13-stars-en
text: Reaching past the stars of Shen and Jing, I look up and hold my breath.

name: v2-cue-13-sigh-en
text: With a hand upon my chest, I sit and sigh.

name: v2-intro-14
text: 林深处，枝影交错。

name: v2-cue-14-light
text: 但见悲鸟，号古木。

name: v2-cue-14-distance
text: 雄飞雌从，绕林间。

name: v2-intro-14-en
text: Deep in the forest, shadows of branches intertwine.

name: v2-cue-14-light-en
text: Only sorrowing birds cry among ancient trees.

name: v2-cue-14-distance-en
text: The male flies; the female follows, circling through the woods.

name: v2-intro-15
text: 一轮寒月，照着无人的山径。

name: v2-cue-15-moon
text: 又闻子规，啼夜月。|愁，空山。

name: v2-intro-15-en
text: A cold moon shines upon a deserted mountain path.

name: v2-cue-15-moon-en
text: And the cuckoo calls beneath the moon. | Sorrow fills the empty mountains.

name: v2-intro-16
text: 林声渐远，水气渐浓。

name: v2-cue-16-torrent
text: 飞湍瀑流争喧豗。|砯崖转石，万壑雷。

name: v2-intro-16-en
text: The forest sounds recede. | The air grows heavy with spray.

name: v2-cue-16-torrent-en
text: Rapids and waterfalls roar together. | They strike the cliffs and tumble stones: thunder in ten thousand ravines.

name: v2-intro-17
text: 蜀门在此。|万山收束成一线。

name: v2-cue-17-far
text: 剑阁峥嵘而崔嵬。

name: v2-cue-17-near
text: 一夫当关。

name: v2-cue-17-knock
text: 万夫，莫开。

name: v2-intro-17-en
text: Here stands the gateway to Shu. | A thousand mountains narrow to a single passage.

name: v2-cue-17-far-en
text: Sword Gate rises, sheer and towering.

name: v2-cue-17-near-en
text: One man guards the pass.

name: v2-cue-17-knock-en
text: Ten thousand cannot break through.

name: v2-intro-18
text: 锦城深处，烟火繁华。

name: v2-cue-18-city
text: 锦城虽云乐。|不如，早还家。

name: v2-intro-18-en
text: Deep in the Brocade City, daily life flourishes.

name: v2-cue-18-city-en
text: Though the Brocade City is a place of pleasure, | better to return home soon.

name: v2-intro-19
text: 千重山外，还有故园。

name: v2-cue-19-home
text: 侧身西望。|长咨嗟。

name: v2-intro-19-en
text: Beyond a thousand mountain folds, home remains.

name: v2-cue-19-home-en
text: I turn and gaze westward. | A long, deep sigh.

name: v2-intro-20
text: 山声渐息，溪色转青。

name: v2-cue-20-fish
text: 闲来垂钓，碧溪上。

name: v2-intro-20-en
text: The mountains fall quiet. | The stream turns clear and green.

name: v2-cue-20-fish-en
text: At leisure, I fish beside a clear green stream.

name: v2-intro-21
text: 一枕江声，浮生入梦。

name: v2-cue-21-dream
text: 忽复乘舟，梦日边。

name: v2-intro-21-en
text: With river sounds beside the pillow, life drifts into a dream.

name: v2-cue-21-dream-en
text: Then, in a dream, I sail in a boat beside the sun.

name: v2-intro-22
text: 长夜将尽，风起沧海。

name: v2-cue-22-sail
text: 长风破浪，会有时。|直挂云帆，济沧海。

name: v2-intro-22-en
text: The long night is ending. | Wind rises over the open sea.

name: v2-cue-22-sail-en
text: One day I shall ride the long wind and break the waves. | I shall raise my cloud-high sail and cross the vast blue sea.

name: v2-intro-23
text: 山海仍在，行歌未止。|愿君怀此心，行向自己的远方。

name: v2-intro-23-en
text: Mountains and seas remain; the song continues. | Carry this spirit towards your own horizon.

name: v2-study-18
text: 锦城虽云乐，不如早还家。从锦城的繁华转向竹溪村舍，画面让“乐”与“还家”的取舍可见。《蜀道难》的劝归和长叹，包含对远行者的关切，也留下人事忧思。

name: v2-study-18-en
text: Though the Brocade City is a place of pleasure, better to return home soon. The view turns from the busy city towards a quiet village beside a bamboo-lined stream. The contrast makes the choice between pleasure and home visible. The poem’s counsel and final sigh retain both care for the traveller and concern about human affairs.
